news.headline: Nektar Shares Surge as Investors Cheer Lilly Verdict and Bullish Analyst Targets
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 15% the day after the $90M Lilly verdict, with the stock trading near $59 as several sell-side analysts maintained double-digit upside price targets. Momentum was reinforced by renewed attention to the positive REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b data ahead of the pending REZOLVE-AA durability readout.

news.headline: Eli Lilly Hit With $90M Verdict In Nektar's Rezpeg Breach Suit
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in its Rezpeg co-development deal with Nektar, awarding Nektar $90 million. The award was well short of the roughly $1 billion Nektar had sought at trial, and remains subject to post-trial motions or appeal.

news.headline: Wedbush Cuts Nektar Price Target to $50 From $80, Keeps Neutral
news.summary: Wedbush lowered its price target on Nektar while maintaining a Neutral rating, citing rezpegaldesleukin safety/discontinuation concerns and a more cautious view on near-term catalysts, just ahead of the favorable Lilly jury verdict.

news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments, Nektar's counsel told the jury that Lilly breached the co-development deal and delayed rezpegaldesleukin's development in favor of a competing drug Lilly later acquired, turning Rezpeg into "damaged goods."

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar began a quiet period on September 8, 2026 that will run until it publicly discloses 24-week off-treatment follow-up data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, expected in Q4 2026.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Full peer-reviewed 16-week induction data from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD study were published in The Lancet, confirming rezpegaldesleukin met all primary and key secondary endpoints with a manageable safety profile dominated by mild-to-moderate injection site reactions.

catalysts.label: Post-trial motions / appeal in Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: A jury awarded Nektar $90M on Sept 24, 2026 for Lilly's breach of the implied covenant of good faith (well below the $1B sought), sending shares up ~15%; the court still must set interest, and the verdict is subject to post-trial motions and possible appeal by either side.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Nektar entered a quiet period on Sept 8, 2026 ahead of this readout, which will show whether hair regrowth persists after dosing stops in the Phase 2b alopecia areata study.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Company-guided timeline reaffirmed in Q2 2026 results, contingent on the REZOLVE-AA durability readout.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third global Phase 3 ZENITH AD study (treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) guided to start in September 2026, following ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 initiation in July 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline data from the Phase 3 registrational atopic dermatitis program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly earnings update on cash runway (>$1B as of June 30, 2026) and pipeline progress.

pulse: Nektar's biggest near-term overhang lifted on Sept 24, 2026 when a jury awarded the company $90M against Eli Lilly for breaching their Rezpeg co-development deal (short of the $1B sought, still subject to post-trial motions/appeal), sending shares up roughly 15% the next day even as Wedbush had just cut its price target to $50 on safety/discontinuation concerns. Attention now shifts to Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA durability data (24-week off-treatment) following the company's Sept 8 quiet period, and to the ramping ZENITH AD Phase 3 atopic dermatitis program (AD-1/AD-2 started July 2026, AD-3 guided for September). The company remains well-capitalized (~$1B cash as of mid-2026) but continues to face pipeline execution risk on both the alopecia and dermatitis fronts as it heads toward its next quarterly update.
